ZAF.note: The source does not say the SARS consultation was run online.

facts.fact: SARS confirmed that its public consultation on the proposed Digital VAT Model closed on 16 October 2026 and that it is analysing submissions from businesses and industry bodies, including SAAFF.

ZAF.note: The Digital VAT Model is a proposal on invoicing and reporting, not stated as electronic payment of tax.
